title: Skin Care for Kozhikode Weather: A Light Routine for Year-Round Humidity and Heavy Monsoons
ex: Humid almost all year, a long heavy monsoon and only a short, mild cool season: a simple, light skin care routine for people living in Kozhikode (Calicut).
rt: Skin Care for Kozhikode Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Kozhikode (Calicut) weather: a light routine for humid heat, damp-towel and sweat care in the heavy monsoon, beach-day sun care and AC tips.
quick: Kozhikode is humid almost all year, with a heavy monsoon from June to September, more rain in October and November, and only slightly cooler, drier weeks from December to February. Use a gentle face wash, a thin gel moisturiser and broad-spectrum sunscreen daily, and a small amount of light night cream.
facts: Kozhikode (Calicut) is on the Malabar coast of north Kerala
The south-west monsoon usually arrives in early June and is heavy
More rain comes in October and November from the north-east monsoon
December to February is a little cooler and drier but still warm
